2610.13786.title: Your Discrete Graph Diffusion Model is Secretly Memorizing
2610.13786.paper_summary: Discrete graph diffusion models (GDMs) corrupt the graph structure by adding noise independently to nodes and edges under a Markovian noise model. In the unconditional setting without node features, an equivariant denoiser trained on a single graph is able to generate novel graphs and sample-level metrics such as edge overlap and WL kernel similarity find no evidence of memorization. In this work, we challenge this view and show for the first time that graph diffusion models indeed exhibit memorization. Analyzing the reverse diffusion trajectories of GDMs trained on two-block stochastic block models (SBMs), we find a strong train-data bias: the model recovers a corrupted training graph almost perfectly compared to a held-out test graph. We term this conditional memorization, as it surfaces only when the reverse trajectory is conditioned on a corrupted training graph and is not apparent during inference. It coincides with a growing generalization gap, where the training loss improves as the loss on held-out graphs degrades, and it cannot be mitigated by early stopping. The onset of memorization always precedes the emergence of community structure in the generated graphs, thus every checkpoint earlier produces structureless graphs. This behavior holds across all node sizes we test.
2610.13786.paper_summary_zh: 離散圖擴散模型 (GDMs) 通過在馬爾可夫噪聲模型下獨立地向節點和邊添加噪聲來破壞圖結構。在沒有節點特徵的無條件設置中，基於單一圖訓練的等變去噪器能夠生成新穎的圖，且樣本級指標如邊重疊和 WL 核相似性並未發現記憶的證據。在這項工作中，我們挑戰了這一觀點，首次顯示圖擴散模型確實表現出記憶現象。分析在兩塊隨機區塊模型 (SBMs) 上訓練的 GDM 的反向擴散軌跡，我們發現了一種強烈的訓練數據偏差：與保留的測試圖相比，模型幾乎完美地恢復了一個損壞的訓練圖。我們將這稱為條件記憶，因為它僅在反向軌跡以損壞的訓練圖為條件時出現，而在推斷過程中並不明顯。這與日益增長的泛化差距相吻合，即訓練損失在保留圖上的損失惡化時有所改善，且無法通過提前停止來緩解。記憶的開始總是先於生成圖中社區結構的出現，因此每個早期的檢查點生成的圖都是無結構的。我們測試的所有節點大小中，這一行為都成立。
2610.13786.author: Adarsh Jamadandi et.al.
